response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, p.average_hgb - o.average_hgb AS above_overall FROM patient_averages p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.average_hgb) SELECT ID, average_hgb, above_overall, average_hgb - (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) FROM above_average) AS above_average_patients_difference FROM above_average ORDER BY above_average_patients_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
